text:
Elena: Partners asked for a coordinated regional onramp for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Proposal: stagger marketplace listings and press to avoid capacity spikes. Thoughts?

Tom: +1. Must gate on lab cert, driver freeze, and SKU naming. SIs want a 7-day early test window.

Vik: Ops note: H200 microcode still has one perf regression ticket. Recommend routing fallback to `h200-quant` and traffic shaping for new sessions.

Sana: Comms: avoid a single global press. Suggest NA -> EU -> APAC over 2 weeks. Need embargo draft by Friday to retain NA slot. @Elena can you own?

Elena: I can own embargo draft. Draft plan: Day 0 SI preview, Day 3 NA limited marketplace, Day 10 EU GA (+MI300 beta), Day 17 APAC GA + final press. Fallbacks: region routing -> quantized variants -> burst pools.

Tom: Please standardize SKU names now (use `redwood-<model>-<variant>-<region>`). Last time naming mismatch broke onboarding.

Vik: I'll add fallback mappings and validate routing in staging by Tue.

Sana: DeployBot, can you post daily status to #partnerships during preview week?

BuildBot: Daily summary scheduled to #partnerships from 2024-08-05 to 2024-08-12.

Elena: If everyone can hit dates I'll lock the plan and schedule a 30m sync with legal + press tomorrow. Confirm?

Tom: Confirmed.

Vik: Confirmed.

Sana: Confirmed.
